svg.title: Facet TD isometric view with toggle to top view
svg.desc: Cave-grey UI study with verified GemTD board geometry. Three illustrative current-round gems appear both on the board and in the five-slot selection summary. Selected ruby details appear lower left. Icon-only toolstrip is lower right on desktop; fixed-angle and rotate camera modes are specified in the handoff.

g.text: Select a placed gem to inspect.

Placement 2: Chipped sapphire, B1, select on board
Placement 3: Flawed amethyst, P2, select on board
